description: A toxic contact dermatitis caused by exposure to paederin from Paederus rove beetles.
causes: Contact with paederin released by Paederus beetles

appearance.general: Localised linear or streaky erythema appears about 24–48 hours after contact and may be followed by vesicles or pustules.

warning_signs: Eye involvement can cause keratoconjunctivitis and warrants medical assessment.
general_first_aid: Wash exposed skin with soap and clean water after contact.
A cold wet compress may help symptoms.
prevention: Avoid crushing beetles on the skin; remove them without crushing.
